notes.title: New game, 'Maze Banquet' Early Access Release
notes.content:
Hello!

Thank you for enjoying the game Blind Girl.

As the next work, I introduce Maze Banquet to you:)

[previewyoutube=seCM5-N5iC4;full][/previewyoutube]

Maze Banquet is a mystery story adventure game.
I'll see you at Early Access in early July, 2020.

Please refer to the link for more information!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1334420/_/?beta=0]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1334420/_/?beta=0[/url]

Thank you.
